Just a quick heads-up about this afternoon."], ["A", "We'll be holding a fire drill at around three fifteen, not at two as stated in last week's e-mail."], ["A", "When the alarm goes off, please stop what you're doing and leave the building by the nearest staircase."], ["A", "Do not use the elevators under any circumstances."], ["A", "Our meeting point is the parking lot behind the building, not the front entrance where we gathered last time."], ["A", "Floor wardens will be wearing orange vests, and they'll check that each area is empty."], ["A", "Once you reach the parking lot, please find your team leader so they can confirm you're there."], ["A", "The whole drill should take about twenty minutes, so you'll be back at your desks by around three thirty-five."], ["A", "I know some of you have client calls this afternoon."], ["A", "If you can't avoid one, let your manager know before lunch, and we'll see what we can do."], ["A", "Last year, it took us almost eight minutes to get everyone out. This time, we're aiming for under five."], ["A", "Thanks for your cooperation."]], {"A": "M-AU"}]
